Summary: As a new user, I need to register in the app so I can use it.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a new user, when I want to use the app, I want to register myself with my full name, email, and password so that I can access the app.

h3. Context

New users need a way to create an account in the app.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* New users can register themselves in the app.
* The registration form includes:
** Full name
** Email
** Password
* The Email should be unique.
*  The password must have at least 8 characters, with at least one number and one special character.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-A1.

Summary: As a registered customer, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can access my account
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a registered customer, when I want to access my account, I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my account.

h3. Context

This issue describes the need for a customer login flow using email and password.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* A registered customer can log in with their email and password.
* After successful login, the customer can go to home page and access their account.
* If given wrong credentials, app should display "Invalid email or password" message.
* After 5 consecutive failed login attempts the account should be locked for 15 minutes.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirements REQ-A2,REQ-A3.

Summary: As a registered user, I can reset my password when I forgot it so that I can access my account.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a registered user, when I forgot my password, I want to reset it so that I can access my account.

h3. Context

The user should receive a reset password link by email.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The reset password link is sent to the user's email.
* The link can be used only once.
* The link is valid for 30 minutes.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-A4.

Summary: As a logged in user, I can log out of my account so that I can end my session.
Creator: Suresh Katta
Description:
h3. User story

As a logged in user, when I want to end my session, I want to log out of my account so that I can finish using the app securely.

h3. Context

Logged in users need a way to log out of their account.

h3. Acceptance criteria

* The user can log out of their account.
* Pressing the browser Back button must not show account pages.

h3. Other information

This story comes under requirement REQ-A5.
